description: Source code for Torch JIT passes related to XNNPACK optimization and graph rewriting, including pattern matching and transformations for convolution, linear, and activation functions, as well as mobile-specific optimizations.

methods.name: replaceConv1dWithConv2d
methods.description: Replaces conv1d pattern with conv2d pattern in the graph.

methods.name: transformConv1dToConv2d
methods.description: Transforms all conv1d operations in the module or graph to conv2d.

methods.name: insertPrePackedLinearOp
methods.description: Inserts prepacked linear operation into the graph, including pattern matching and rewriting.

methods.name: insertPrePackedConv2dOp
methods.description: Inserts prepacked conv2d operations, including pattern matching and rewriting.

methods.name: fuseHardtanhWithPackedOps
methods.description: Fuses Hardtanh activation with prepacked operations.

methods.name: fuseReluWithPackedOps
methods.description: Fuses ReLU activation with prepacked operations.

methods.name: runCanonicalOptimizations
methods.description: Runs general optimization passes on the module.

methods.name: insertPrePackedOps
methods.description: Inserts prepacked ops into the graph or module.

methods.name: fusePrePackedLinearConvWithClamp
methods.description: Fuses prepacked linear and convolution operations with clamp functions.

methods.name: FoldPrePackingOps
methods.description: Folds prepacking operations to optimize graph.

methods.name: optimizeForMobile
methods.description: Performs mobile-specific graph optimizations, including conv1d to conv2d transformation, batch norm folding, and other passes.
